_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.vi: Từ bẫy: actually ≠ atualmente (= currently, hiện nay)
mistake.l1: Portuguese “atualmente” means currently, so learners use actually for now.

segments.text: Actually, or currently? Many learners mix them up.
Currently means now. I currently live in Brazil.
Actually means in fact. Actually, I love rainy days.
Repeat after me. I currently work from home.

native.caption: Falso cognato! “currently” = {m:currently}, e “actually” = {m:actually}. Então “Actually, I love rainy days” quer dizer “Na verdade, eu amo dias de chuva”. Repita com o Carlos e a Ama e pratique vocabulário no app Lexkite.

en.caption: False friend! “currently” = {m:currently}, and “actually” = {m:actually}. So “Actually, I love rainy days” means “In fact, I love rainy days”. Repeat with Carlos and Ama and practice vocabulary in the Lexkite app.
